segments.name: Software
segments.description: Cloud and on-premise content management and payables automation software for small-to-medium businesses and governmental customers.
segments.evidence: The Software segment provides cloud-based and premise-based content services software, including document management and payables automation.

segments.name: Document Services
segments.description: Paper-to-digital scanning, micrographics, outsourcing and records storage services for businesses and government agencies.
segments.evidence: The Document Services segment provides services for scanning and indexing, converting images from paper to digital, paper to microfilm, and microfiche to microfilm, as well as long-term physical document storage and retrieval.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for software-as-a-service access, maintenance, and document scanning and storage services, sold directly or through channel partners.
revenueModel.evidence: Under these agreements, we generally provide access to the applicable software, data storage and related customer assistance and support.
